steps.what: Find the actual case status and current case-management directions in the court case-management system {OTHER}.
Read the actual procedural requirements and directions, checking the clerk's communication authority and any matter requiring the judicial officer's decision.
outputs: Verified procedural position and communication limits

steps.what: Communicate with counsel regarding case management or procedural requirements, clarifying the actual question without offering a new ruling or private substantive advice.
outputs: Actual procedural communication and clarified points

steps.what: Draft the actual written procedural confirmation in {EMAIL}, using the case identity and verified directions without inventing dates or decisions.
Check the completed confirmation's meaning, case, dates, recipients and consistency with the actual directions and permitted communication scope.
Send the exact checked procedural confirmation to the verified counsel recipients through {EMAIL}.
inputs: Exact confirmation and recipients checked in s5

steps.what: Write and check the actual communication outcome and sent correspondence reference in the court case-record draft {OTHER}.
Save the exact checked communication entry in the court case record {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure native case-source views in the court case-management system {OTHER} and approved confirmation fields in {EMAIL}. The clerk interprets the actual directions, communicates personally, checks the completed confirmation and records the actual outcome after sending.
tasks.previous_blocker: Case directions and repeated correspondence fields are retrieved and copied manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case views and approved correspondence fields.
tasks.still_hard: Procedural exceptions and the limits of a clerk's authority.
tasks.human_edge: Clear, impartial communication and escalation of matters needing a judicial decision.

ambition.what: No additional judicial decision authority is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less retrieval and repeated field entry; communication responsibility stays unchanged.

reach.learn: Recognise the boundary between procedural communication and a ruling

evidence.claim: Native docket views and approved correspondence fields can reduce clerical retrieval and repeated entry without interpreting legal requirements automatically.

assumptions: Conditional cycle includes counsel discussion, actual written confirmation and brief existing case entry. Shares are E1 estimates, not measured court baselines.

Court sources already contain case id, direction text, version and actual dates. Clerk retrieves them in s1, reads authority and requirements in s2 and produces actual communication in s3. Missing fields require manual source reading; no free deadline calculation or conversation transcript is assumed.

Test native source views and approved field templates first. Only repeated identifiers and direction references change in s4; substantive interpretation and recipient checks remain human. No judicial decision or date extension is issued automatically.

Ordinary final-version checks supply requested gates without added self-approval work; edits void them. The short save and send remain fully counted. Court-specific confidentiality and national procedures require local verification.
research_questions: Can native views and fields reduce retrieval and copying while preserving the exact judicial direction?

already_counted.description: Residual lookup, procedural interpretation, conversation, written content, full checks, actual entry and tails remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain source links and approved confirmation fields.

approvals.approved_version: Exact confirmation and recipients checked in s5
Exact actual communication entry checked in s7

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15 x 40% retrieval + 16 x 20% repeated fields = 9.2 gross less 1 upkeep. Already configured views yield no benefit; no conversation, legal judgment or tail saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Answer general legal questions from court staff

steps.what: Clarify the actual general legal question from judicial officers or court staff, its jurisdiction and the boundary from case-specific decision making.
Research the actual question in the authorised legal research system {OTHER}, finding relevant current source passages and citations.
outputs: Source-linked research draft and unresolved points

loop.purpose: Locate and summarise sources for a scoped general legal question
loop.input: Actual question and authorised current legal source texts
loop.output: Candidate answer passages with resolving source identifiers and explicit gaps
loop.check: Clerk opens original sources and checks current status, jurisdiction, exceptions, quoted meaning and support for every proposition
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; any unresolved citation or substantive conflict returns to manual research
loop.why_not_simpler: Native citation and keyword search runs first, but connecting differently worded general questions to source passages requires contextual reading

steps.what: Read the original sources and determine the actual general legal answer, limitations and points requiring judicial consideration.
Respond to questions from judicial officers or court staff on general legal issues, explaining the verified answer and its limits and addressing follow-up questions.
inputs: Verified answer and limits from s3

steps.what: Write and check the actual requested internal research note in {DOCS}, retaining the verified legal meaning, source references and unresolved issues.
Save the exact checked internal research note in the authorised {DOCS} workspace.

tasks.design: Test native legal-source search in the authorised research system {OTHER}, then a bounded source-linked research draft only if local court policy allows this low-risk general research use. The clerk reads originals, determines the answer, responds personally and checks the actual note before saving it in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: General questions use wording that differs from relevant legal sources.
tasks.enabler_now: Authorised retrieval with bounded source-linked reading assistance.
tasks.still_hard: Current legal meaning, exceptions and the boundary from deciding a case.

ambition.what: No automated judicial advice or outcome decision is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less source-finding work, with interpretation and judicial authority unchanged.

reach.task: Frame questions for further legal research
reach.learn: Source currency, contrary authority and limits of general answers

evidence.claim: Source-bound retrieval can assist legal research but every citation and proposition still needs original-source checking.

assumptions: Boundary is a general legal question, actual discussion and requested internal note. No application of law to case facts, ruling or external legal opinion is automated. Shares are E1 conditional estimates.

Clerk produces the scoped question in s1. Licensed source maintainers provide source id, jurisdiction, version/current status and full text; clerk accesses these in s2 and manually verifies originals in s3. Missing or inaccessible sources trigger manual research, never generated citations.

Native search and templates are tested first. Bounded assistance is conditional on actual court permission and access; absent permission, native search and human research remain and the saving must be repriced. No confidential material enters an unauthorised service.

s5 only reduces reference and heading placement; legal prose and checks remain human. The ordinary completed-note check is the requested gate, not extra self-approval labour. Edits void it; no runtime or save-tail saving.
research_questions: Can authorised retrieval shorten actual source finding while preserving contrary authority and full original-source verification?

already_counted.description: Actual question, residual research, original-source verification, explanation, note review and save remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain source mappings and sample citation and proposition support.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed research note checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 35 x 50% research assistance + 9 x 20% reference placement = 19.3 gross less 2 upkeep. Permission, licensing or unsuitable questions may yield zero; legal reasoning and discussion retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the actual authoritative order, filing receipt or approved case instruction supplying information for the computerized court calendar, filing or case management system {OTHER}.
outputs: Read source fields and source identity

steps.what: Verify the actual target case, entry type, source version and fields authorised for entry, resolving missing or conflicting information manually.
outputs: Verified target and authorised source-field selection

steps.what: Enter information into computerized court calendar, filing, or case management systems {OTHER}, transcribing the actual selected source fields into a staged entry draft.
inputs: Verified target and source-field selection from s2

steps.what: Reconcile the completed staged entry to the actual authoritative source, checking case, field meaning, exact dates, entry type and any effect on existing entries.
Commit the exact checked entry to the court calendar, filing or case management system {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure an existing source-to-draft mapping in the court case-management system {OTHER} for an authorised structured source. Keep source reading, target selection and full completed-entry reconciliation human, with a separate final commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Already available authoritative source fields are retyped into the case system.
tasks.enabler_now: Native import and staging mappings where actually supported.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting instructions and consequences of an incorrect date or case association.
tasks.human_edge: Reconciling the entry to the authoritative source and recognising exceptions.

ambition.what: No automated legal deadline determination is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less transcription, with court-entry authority unchanged.

reach.learn: Court-system entry semantics and correction controls

evidence.claim: A native structured import can stage court-system fields from an authoritative source while leaving final reconciliation and commit human.

assumptions: Conditional baseline is actual manual transcription from an already structured source, not automatic system runtime or every court entry. Shares are E1 estimates that require measurement.

The authorised source-producing court process supplies case reference, instruction/version id, entry type, actual date/time where applicable, filing reference and source text. Clerk reads these in s1 and verifies selection in s2. If the source is only narrative, incomplete or conflicting, entry remains manual and s3 savings do not apply; no free extraction is presumed.

Test native mapping and staging before custom integration. No new legal date, filing decision or public notification is created. Any separate notification workflow remains unchanged and earns no saving here.
Full completed-entry reconciliation in s4 supplies the exact-version commit gate; edits void it. Same-system commit retains its real short time. No source-producer labour is transferred or saved.
research_questions: Can the native import stage actual fields without changing date meaning, case identity or existing entries?

already_counted.description: Actual source reading, target checks, full completed-entry reconciliation and commit remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain field mappings and handle import-format exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed court entry reconciled in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 45 actual transcription points removed less 3 upkeep = 42 net. Narrative-only sources, absent staging or existing automatic transfer yield zero benefit; source, checks and commit retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Verify availability and order of case papers

steps.what: Retrieve the actual case docket, required document sequence and available files, complaints or other papers from the court case-management system {OTHER}.
outputs: Actual document set and required sequence

steps.what: Verify that all files, complaints, or other papers are available and in the proper order by comparing actual digital filing identifiers and sequence against the existing docket in {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual document set and required sequence from s1
outputs: Draft missing-file, duplicate and sequence exception list

steps.what: Inspect the actual papers and digital originals for identity, readable content, attachments and physical completeness, checking the proposed exceptions rather than trusting a filename match.
outputs: Verified real file conditions and exceptions

steps.what: Locate actual misplaced or unclear documents in the available case sources and verify their identity before proposing any order correction.
Clarify remaining document gaps with court staff using actual case and filing references; leave unresolved files explicitly incomplete.
Stage the verified file sequence corrections in the court case-management system {OTHER} without changing document content or declaring missing papers present.
Write the actual brief verification status and check it with the completed staged sequence and remaining gaps in {OTHER}.
outputs: Checked exact sequence correction and status entry

steps.what: Commit the exact checked file sequence and verification status in the court case-management system {OTHER}.
inputs: Exact sequence and status checked in s7
outputs: Committed actual file order and verification status

tasks.design: Configure native docket views and exact filing-id/sequence comparisons in the court case-management system {OTHER}. The clerk checks real document content and physical completeness, resolves gaps and separately commits the verified sequence and brief status; an identifier match never proves substantive completeness.
tasks.previous_blocker: Digital filing identifiers and expected sequence are manually compared one by one.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case views and configured missing-document or sequence checks.
tasks.still_hard: Whether an apparently present document is the correct complete original.
tasks.human_edge: Inspecting real papers and resolving ambiguous filing evidence.

ambition.what: No automatic legal completeness certification is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less mechanical comparison, with substantive verification unchanged.

reach.task: Identify missing material before a hearing
reach.learn: File provenance and limits of docket metadata

evidence.claim: Exact identifier and sequence checks can flag mechanical filing exceptions while document content and physical completeness require human inspection.

assumptions: Conditional baseline includes actual manual digital comparison plus physical and substantive verification. Shares are E1 estimates, not measured court facts. A paper-only packet or already automatic comparison requires repricing.

Existing court filing processes supply case id, filing id, actual received-document references and docket sequence. Clerk retrieves and verifies these in s1; no new source-capture work is shifted to another worker. Missing metadata requires manual comparison, not invented file presence.

Native case views and exact comparisons are tested before code. s2 only compares existing metadata and flags uncertainty. Actual inspection, gap finding, staff clarification and sequence staging retain all time. No automatic deletion, legal sufficiency ruling or external notice is hidden in the design.

The existing brief closeout check on the completed sequence supplies the requested commit gate with no extra self-approval labour. Changes void it. Same-system commit remains a short fully retained action; existing runtime earns no saving.
research_questions: Does a native exception view reduce manual comparison without masking wrong originals, missing attachments or unresolved gaps?

already_counted.description: Residual retrieval, physical and substantive inspection, gap resolution, actual staging, status check and commit remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain expected-sequence mappings and check exception-view failures.

approvals.approved_version: Exact completed file sequence and status checked in s7

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20 x 50% retrieval + 35 actual identifier comparison = 45 gross less 2 upkeep. Paper-only or already automated cases yield zero; physical, substantive and commit work retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Legal interpretation and court authority remain human; repeated source retrieval and clerical comparison can shrink.
role.ambitious_version: A clerk who spends less time transcribing and comparing records while preserving impartial communication, legal interpretation and reliable case files.
